extra_vocab.en: to put something firmly inside another thing
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報中，embedding a sensor ... directly into the packaging 說明 ColdLink 的技術特色：感測器直接嵌入包裝內，不需要另外黏貼。這是產品說明與簡報裡常見的正式用字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: embed + 物 + in / into + 位置；被動用 be embedded in。

example.en: The designer embeds a small logo into every product label.
example.zh: 設計師在每張產品標籤中嵌入一個小標誌。

example.en: The technician embedded the sensors before the boxes were sealed.
example.zh: 技術人員在箱子封好前就把感測器嵌入了。

example.en: An embedded sensor measures the temperature inside the sealed box.
example.zh: 嵌入式感測器會測量密封箱內的溫度。

example.en: Embedding sensors early in production lowers the overall cost.
example.zh: 在生產初期就嵌入感測器能降低整體成本。

example.en: Some banks embed a chip in every credit card.
example.zh: 有些銀行會在每張信用卡中嵌入晶片。

example.en: The tracking code is embedded in the label itself.
example.zh: 追蹤碼就嵌在標籤本身裡面。

example.en: Embedded software controls how the machine reads each tag.
example.zh: 嵌入式軟體控制機器如何讀取每個標籤。

examples.en: The engineers will embed the tracking device directly into the package.
examples.zh: 工程師會把追蹤裝置直接嵌入包裝中。

examples.en: You can embed the demo video directly into your web page.
examples.zh: 您可以把示範影片直接嵌入您的網頁。

examples.en: The company wants to embed safety habits into daily routines.
examples.zh: 公司希望讓安全習慣深植於日常作業。

confusable.diff: embed 是「嵌入」；embark 是「著手、登上」，常用 embark on，兩字開頭相同但意思不同。

example.en: The firm will embark on a new project next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月將展開一項新專案。

similar.diff: install 是安裝設備或軟體，不一定藏在內部；embed 強調牢牢嵌入其中。

example.en: The technician will install the sensor system next week.
example.zh: 技術人員下週會安裝這套感測系統。

similar.diff: integrate 是把兩個系統或功能整合在一起；embed 是把物件放進另一個物件裡。

example.en: We will integrate the tag data with our tracking software.
example.zh: 我們會把標籤資料與追蹤軟體整合在一起。

example.en: Please attach the label to the side of the carton.
example.zh: 請把標籤貼在紙箱側面。

example.en: Insert the card into the reader and wait for the signal.
example.zh: 把卡片插入讀卡機，等候訊號。

example.en: Each component is tested before it goes into the device.
example.zh: 每個零組件在放進裝置前都會經過測試。

senses.en: to fix something firmly inside another thing
senses.distinguish: 後面接實體物件與位置，如 embed a sensor in the packaging。

example.en: A tiny battery is embedded inside the smart tag.
example.zh: 一顆小電池嵌在這個智慧標籤裡面。

senses.en: to make an idea or habit a normal part of something
senses.distinguish: 後面接習慣、價值或文化等抽象的東西，常和 in / into 一起用。

example.en: Regular training helps embed good safety habits in every employee.
example.zh: 定期訓練有助於讓良好的安全習慣深植在每位員工身上。

extra_vocab.en: to make a process or job happen faster
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報中，helped expedite clearance 指電子溫度紀錄讓海關更快放行。expedite 常用在通關、訂單、審核等「手續與流程」，語氣正式，比 speed up 更商務。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: expedite 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞（expedite the process），不加 up；意思與 speed up 相近，但更正式。

example.en: A direct flight expedites the transfer of medical supplies.
example.zh: 直飛班機加快了醫療物資的運送。

example.en: The manager expedited the approval so we could start on Monday.
example.zh: 經理加快了核准流程，讓我們星期一就能開始。

example.en: We paid extra for expedited handling of the fragile goods.
example.zh: 我們多付費用，讓易碎貨物得到加急處理。

example.en: Expediting the audit will save the department several days of work.
example.zh: 加快稽核能為部門省下好幾天的工作時間。

example.en: Online forms expedite the process of approving new contracts.
example.zh: 線上表單加快了核准新合約的流程。

example.en: We can expedite delivery for an extra fee of twenty dollars.
example.zh: 加收二十美元，我們可以加急配送。

example.en: Expedited shipping is available for urgent orders only.
example.zh: 加急運送僅限緊急訂單使用。

examples.en: Complete documents will expedite the customs clearance for your cargo.
examples.zh: 文件齊全會加快您貨物的通關。

examples.en: We asked the supplier to expedite the order before the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們請供應商在假期前加快處理這筆訂單。

examples.en: A new software tool helps expedite refund requests from customers.
examples.zh: 新的軟體工具有助於加快處理客戶的退款申請。

confusable.diff: expedite 是動詞「加快」；expedition 是名詞「遠征、探險」，拼法相近但用法不同。

example.en: The company funded an expedition to study ocean temperatures.
example.zh: 公司資助了一趟研究海洋溫度的探險。

similar.diff: speed up 較口語，可用於任何事物；expedite 較正式，專指加快手續、流程或訂單。

example.en: New equipment will speed up the packing process at the warehouse.
example.zh: 新設備將加快倉庫的包裝流程。

similar.diff: accelerate 強調速度或成長的加快；expedite 強調讓事情更快辦完。

example.en: The company hopes to accelerate its expansion into Asia.
example.zh: 公司希望加快拓展到亞洲的腳步。

example.en: Customs clearance usually takes one or two business days.
example.zh: 通關通常需要一到兩個工作天。

example.en: Urgent orders are given priority over regular ones.
example.zh: 緊急訂單比一般訂單優先處理。

example.en: We plan to streamline the approval steps this year.
example.zh: 我們今年打算簡化核准的步驟。

derived.link: expedite 去掉 -e 加 -ious，變成形容詞「迅速的」，像 ambitious、cautious；多見於正式文件

extra_vocab.en: in a bad way, or not well enough
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報中，were poorly produced 是用在被動句裡的副詞，說明商品「製作不良」；作者要強調腐壞的真正原因是運輸溫度，不是品質不好。poorly 常放在過去分詞前，描述品質或做法差。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: poorly 是副詞，常放在過去分詞前組成 poorly managed 這類說法；修飾名詞要用形容詞 poor（a poor result），不能用 poorly。

example.en: A poorly designed label confused the warehouse workers.
example.zh: 一張設計不良的標籤讓倉庫員工感到困惑。

example.en: Poorly managed projects often run over budget and behind schedule.
example.zh: 管理不善的專案常常超出預算又落後進度。

example.en: Many seasonal jobs are poorly paid but easy to learn.
example.zh: 許多季節性工作薪水偏低，但很容易學。

example.en: The workshop was poorly attended because of the heavy rain.
example.zh: 因為下大雨，這場工作坊的出席人數很少。

examples.en: The batch failed inspection because it was poorly sealed.
examples.zh: 這批貨沒通過檢查，因為封裝不良。

examples.en: Poorly trained staff can damage a company's reputation quickly.
examples.zh: 訓練不足的員工很快就會損害公司的名聲。

examples.en: The seminar was poorly organized, so many guests left early.
examples.zh: 這場研討會籌辦得很差，所以許多賓客提早離開。

similar.diff: badly 也有「差勁地」的意思，另可表示「嚴重地」（badly damaged）；poorly 較強調品質或表現不好。

example.en: The shipment was badly damaged during the storm.
example.zh: 這批貨在暴風雨中嚴重受損。

similar.diff: inadequately 較正式，強調「不夠充分」；poorly 範圍更廣，指做得差。

example.en: The warehouse was inadequately prepared for the sudden increase in orders.
example.zh: 倉庫對訂單突然增加的準備並不充分。

example.en: Please return any defective items within thirty days.
example.zh: 有缺陷的商品請在三十天內退回。

example.en: Inferior materials will harm the quality of the final product.
example.zh: 劣質材料會損害最終產品的品質。

example.en: The inspector rejected the substandard packaging materials.
example.zh: 檢查員拒收了不合標準的包裝材料。

derived.link: 基本形容詞「差的」；poor + -ly，變成副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: in a bad way, not well
senses.distinguish: 修飾動詞或過去分詞，指做法或品質差，如 poorly produced。

example.en: The leaflet was poorly printed, so the text was hard to read.
example.zh: 這份傳單印刷品質很差，文字很難閱讀。

senses.en: not enough or at a low level
senses.distinguish: 和 lit、equipped、attended 等字連用，指程度或數量不足。

example.en: The meeting room was poorly lit, so we moved to another one.
example.zh: 會議室的照明不足，所以我們換到另一間。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報中，the results were superb 是簡報者讚美試驗成果，語氣強烈正面，用來增加產品的可信度。常見於評價、推薦信與服務品質的描述。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: superb 本身已是最高級的讚美，不加 very，也不用比較級；要加強語氣可用 absolutely 或 truly。

example.en: The jacket is made of superb quality leather.
example.zh: 這件夾克是用品質絕佳的皮革製成。

example.en: We chose this restaurant for its superb service and fair prices.
example.zh: 我們選這間餐廳是因為它的服務極佳且價格公道。

example.en: The team earned a bonus for its superb performance this quarter.
example.zh: 團隊因本季的傑出表現而獲得獎金。

examples.en: Customers described the hotel's customer service as simply superb.
examples.zh: 顧客形容這間飯店的客戶服務簡直太棒了。

examples.en: Her presentation skills are superb, and clients always ask for her.
examples.zh: 她的簡報技巧非常出色，客戶總是指名要她。

examples.en: The camera takes superb photos even in very low light.
examples.zh: 這台相機即使在很暗的光線下也能拍出絕佳的照片。

confusable.diff: superb 是「極好的」，不用於比較；superior 是「較優越的」，常接 to 表示優於某物。
confusable.usage: superior 後面接 to（superior to…）來做比較；superb 不用於比較，也不接 to。

example.en: Our new model is superior to the old one in speed.
example.zh: 我們的新機型在速度上優於舊機型。

similar.diff: excellent 更常見、語氣中性；superb 的讚美語氣更強烈。

example.en: The results of the pilot test were excellent overall.
example.zh: 試行測試的結果整體來說非常好。

similar.diff: outstanding 強調「出類拔萃、特別突出」；superb 強調「品質極佳」。

example.en: She received an outstanding employee award last year.
example.zh: 她去年獲頒傑出員工獎。

example.en: Your report was excellent and very easy to follow.
example.zh: 您的報告非常出色，也很容易理解。

example.en: The company won an outstanding service award this year.
example.zh: 公司今年獲得傑出服務獎。

example.en: The sales growth in the second quarter was impressive.
example.zh: 第二季的銷售成長令人印象深刻。

derived.link: superb + -ly，變成副詞，像 quick → quickly，如 superbly organized

extra_vocab.en: a unit of length; one hundredth of a meter
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報中，only three centimeters wide 用具體數字強調感測器的尺寸很小，方便嵌入包裝。centimeter 是美式拼法，英式拼法是 centimetre。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「寬 X 公分」用 X centimeters wide；當形容詞放在名詞前要用連字號且不加 s，如 a three-centimeter gap。

example.en: The two boxes differ by only a few centimeters in height.
example.zh: 這兩個箱子的高度只差幾公分。

example.en: The pressure on each square centimeter must stay below the limit.
example.zh: 每平方公分承受的壓力必須低於上限。

example.en: The label is ten centimeters wide and five centimeters tall.
example.zh: 這張標籤寬十公分、高五公分。

example.en: The foam layer must be at least two centimeters thick.
example.zh: 泡棉層至少要有兩公分厚。

examples.en: The tag is thicker than one centimeter, so it needs a larger slot.
examples.zh: 這個標籤厚度超過一公分，所以需要更大的卡槽。

examples.en: Leave a gap of at least one centimeter between the boxes.
examples.zh: 箱子之間請至少留一公分的空隙。

examples.en: Each shelf is adjustable by steps of one centimeter.
examples.zh: 每層架子可以以一公分為單位調整。

similar.diff: inch 是英制單位，一英吋約 2.54 公分；centimeter 是公制單位。

example.en: The box is ten inches long, or about twenty-five centimeters.
example.zh: 這個箱子長十英吋，約二十五公分。

example.en: Please check the width of the door before ordering.
example.zh: 訂購前請先確認門的寬度。

example.en: The length of the cable is two meters.
example.zh: 這條電纜的長度是兩公尺。

example.en: The dimensions of the package are printed on the label.
example.zh: 包裹的尺寸印在標籤上。

derived.link: 基本長度單位「公尺」；加 centi-（百分之一）就是 centimeter
milli-（千分之一）+ meter，比 centimeter 更小的單位
